label: Whatever is composed of matter and form, or has an act of being other…, from distinct constituents
meaning: Matter-form composites and things whose esse differs from their essence are composite, from an OPEN component analysis (two distinct constituent principles suffice for composition) and two OPEN analyses: a matter-form composite has two distinct constituents, and distinct esse and essence are both constituents. The distinctness of esse from essence is used as the distinctness of the two constituents.
